title: Why The World Relies On ASML For Machines That Print Chips
summary: CNBC gets a tour of ASML's cleanrooms in the Netherlands to see how its roughly $200 million EUV lithography machines are built. It covers exploding molten tin, ultra-flat optics and why only one company can make these systems.
why: Frequently recommended as a good, approachable overview of ASML and semiconductor equipment.

quote.text: Good video on ASML and semiconductor fabrication equipment in general
